def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Fix Category label variants
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip()
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace({'Office Suplies': 'Office Supplies', 'Furnture': 'Furniture'})
    # Drop rows with negative Quantity (invalid per rules)
    df = df[df['Quantity'] >= 1].reset_index(drop=True)
    # Fix Region: strip extra spaces and normalize case
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.strip()
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.title()
    return df
